method: Break the eggs into a vessel and beat them well.
Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, chili powder, salt, color powder, rice flour, and cumin powder to the beaten eggs. Mix well.
Add the chopped cauliflower to this mixture and coat them thoroughly.
Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, drop the cauliflower pieces in small batches and fry them until done.
**Cumin Powder:** Roast cumin seeds and grind them in a mixer to prepare fresh powder.
**Coriander Powder:** Roast coriander seeds and grind them in a mixer.
**Ginger-Garlic Paste:** Grind equal amounts of ginger and garlic with a little water in a mixer.
